todos.description: Populate data/superconductor_database.json with verified entries for known superconductors (e.g., NbTi, YBCO, MgB2, FeSe, H3S, LaH10) including Tc, structure, pressure, and reference fields.

Implement predict_tc function in scripts/predict_tc.py using the McMillan-Allen-Dynes equation, including parameters for electron-phonon coupling constant, logarithmic average frequency, and Coulomb pseudopotential.
Delete duplicate test file tests/tests_predict_tc.py (the correct test file is tests/test_predict_tc.py).

Consolidate duplicate documents: move canonical versions to docs/ directory, remove root duplicates (candidate_materials.md, characterization_techniques.md, literature_review.md, synthesis_methods.md, theoretical_framework.md, roadmap.md), and update all cross-references in README.md to point to docs/ versions.

Also (council-synthesis): Add sections on electron-phonon coupling, dynamical mean-field theory (DMFT), and spin fluctuations to theoretical_framework.md, with equations and references.

Also (council-synthesis): Fix broken link in README.md to discovery_strategy.md by either moving discovery_strategy.md into docs/ and updating the link, or updating the link to the correct relative path.
Add detailed synthesis protocols for YH10, CaH12, and MgH16 in proposed_chemistry_physics.md, including high-pressure synthesis conditions, precursor materials, and characterization steps.

Update docs/online_research_summary.md with findings from at least 5 recent papers (2020+) on hydrides, nickelates, and carbon-based superconductors, including key results and implications for room-temperature superconductivity.
